item.summary: Today, crores of Indians across the country and in every corner of the world are celebrating the sacred festival of lights. People are travelling from far and wide to reach their homes. It is a great festival of meeting and spending time with family and loved ones. And I too have come among you to celebrate Diwali. Whether on the borders or within the country, all of you who defend the nation,…
item.title: English rendering of PM's speech during interaction with the Security Forces in Bastar, Chhattisgarh
